title: Keep brokerage amounts under the correct column headings
summary: The optional financial table reader can recover overlapping brokerage column headings when the original PDF proves their layout.
bodyMarkdown:
## What changed

The optional financial table reader uses the original PDF to recover overlapping 1099-B column headings when the printed words and transaction rows agree. Amounts and transaction rows remain unchanged.

## Why it matters

This can recover a table that previously required manual review without guessing whether an amount is proceeds or cost basis. Ambiguous layouts still require review; recovered headings do not approve tax facts.

## Where to find it

Use Extract Tables in the PDF toolbox when the optional financial table reader is enabled. General rollout remains under qualification.
